from labutil import *
import time
for attempt in range(120):
 apps=j('-n','argocd','get','applications')['items'];status={a['metadata']['name']:{'sync':a.get('status',{}).get('sync',{}).get('status'),'health':a.get('status',{}).get('health',{}).get('status'),'conditions':a.get('status',{}).get('conditions',[])} for a in apps}
 if set(status)=={'sealed-secrets','proxmox-csi','sqlite'} and all(x['sync']=='Synced' and x['health']=='Healthy' for x in status.values()):break
 if attempt%6==0:print(json.dumps(status),flush=True)
 time.sleep(5)
else:save('application-failure.json',status);raise RuntimeError('Lab applications failed to become Synced Healthy')
save('applications-initial.json',status)
pv=j('get','pv','csi-lab-sqlite');pvc=j('-n','csi-lab','get','pvc','sqlite');assert pvc['status']['phase']=='Bound' and pv['spec']['persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy']=='Retain'
assert pv['spec']['csi']['volumeHandle']=='lab//csi-integration-20261004/9980/vm-9980-integration.raw'
initial=json.loads(k('-n','csi-lab','exec','-i','deploy/sqlite','--','python','-','init',input=(R/'sqlite-probe.py').read_text()));assert initial['rows']==1000
save('sqlite-initial.json',initial)
attachments=[]
for vmid in [981,982,983]:
 c=api('GET',f'/nodes/pve/qemu/{vmid}/config')
 for slot,value in c.items():
  if slot.startswith('scsi') and isinstance(value,str) and value.startswith('csi-integration-20261004:9980/vm-9980-integration.raw,'):attachments.append({'vmid':vmid,'slot':slot,'config':value})
assert len(attachments)==1 and attachments[0]['vmid']==982,attachments
disks=json.loads(node(982,'lsblk -J -o NAME,UUID,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINTS\n'))['blockdevices'];mounted=[d for d in disks if d.get('fstype')=='ext4' and any(m and m.endswith('/globalmount') for m in d.get('mountpoints',[]))];assert len(mounted)==1
save('volume-initial.json',{'attachment':attachments[0],'filesystem':mounted[0],'pv':pv,'pvc':pvc})
save('image-pins.json',[{'namespace':p['metadata']['namespace'],'pod':p['metadata']['name'],'containers':[{'name':c['name'],'imageID':c['imageID']} for c in p['status'].get('containerStatuses',[])]} for p in j('get','pods','-A')['items']])
tf(['plan','-input=false','-detailed-exitcode'],'terraform-with-csi.log')
print(json.dumps({'applications':'Synced Healthy','rows':initial['rows'],'integrity':initial['integrity'],'filesystem_uuid':mounted[0]['uuid'],'single_attachment_vmid':982,'terraform_plan':'no changes'}),flush=True)

changes=[x for x in p.get('resource_changes',[]) if x['change']['actions']!=['no-op']]
assert len(changes)==1 and changes[0]['address']=='module.worker_1.proxmox_vm_qemu.vm' and changes[0]['change']['actions']==['delete','create']
save('worker-replacement-plan.json',{'changes':[{'address':x['address'],'actions':x['change']['actions']} for x in changes],'old_uuid':'d4171e20-a396-4d00-95ff-9f181132f166'})
# Preserve one pre-existing cordon through the exact native drain handoff.
k('cordon','csi-int-worker-2');assert j('get','node','csi-int-worker-2')['spec']['unschedulable']
root=R/'maintenance';root.mkdir(mode=0o770,exist_ok=True);(root/'runner-instance').write_text('cfe2408d-247b-4727-8c09-106c8859b842\n')
assert not (root/'operation.json').exists()
os.environ['HOMELAB_RUNNER_INSTANCE']='cfe2408d-247b-4727-8c09-106c8859b842';os.environ['MAINTENANCE_OWNER']='lab/worker-one';os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT']=str(R/'worker-handoff.txt')
a=json.loads((R/'private/terraform-token.json').read_text());os.environ['PM_API_TOKEN_ID']=a['token_id'];os.environ['PM_API_TOKEN_SECRET']=a['token_secret']
os.environ['TF_CLI_ARGS_apply']='-parallelism=1'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'terraform-source/scripts'));import maintenance_apply
os.chdir(R/'tf-work');Path('plan.exitcode').write_text('2\n')
maintenance_apply.execute('drain',True,root)
assert not (root/'operation.json').exists();m=memory_guard()
print('Native drain/apply completed; successful handoff saved; available GiB '+str(round(m/2**30,2)),flush=True)
